I kind of think it could be before then, as only one prince can hold

the "first tournament where they are given to participants".

In truth, however, this theoretical day is actually resolved by
decree of the Organized Play Coordinator - and the resolution is
typically posted via the "promo checklist" on the White Wolf
website:

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=checklist_Promos

To find the date in question, click on the card and you will be
taken to its entry in the official V:TES Card List where the
officially recognized promo release date is given via an entry
next to the card name - e.g. "House of Sorrow (Promo - 20081119)"
signifying that House of Sorrow's release date was determined to
be November 19, 2008.

I gather the people posing the question in this thread are waiting
for entries to be made for these new promo card so no one need
bicker about the officially recognized date. Or Oscar just posting
the date(s) here would also work.

Fred
